title: Baluni
description: Baluni, a modpack built on top of Fabulously Optimized with some extra flavor.
body:
# Baluni

Baluni is a modpack designed for survival builders who want to tackle large-scale projects without compromising on performance or quality of life. Built on top of [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), it inherits all the performance optimizations while adding essential tools and visual improvements.

If you only need performance improvements, stick with Fabulously Optimized. Baluni is for players who want/need more.

## Who is this for?

Baluni was created for Maçada SMP but works well for any survival player working on large builds. Performance should remain identical to Fabulously Optimized.

## What does it add?

**Building Tools**: Litematica and WorldEdit are included to help you plan and execute large builds. Use Litematica to preview your creations in survival, then build them efficiently with all the visual guides you need. WorldEdit handles the heavy lifting when you need to move or modify structures.

**Quality of Life**: Click through signs and item frames with ClickThrough Plus. See armor durability and saturation with AppleSkin. Check shulker box contents without opening them. Xaero's Minimap and World Map keep you oriented during mega projects. InvMove lets you manage inventory while walking, and Client Sort organizes your chests instantly.

**Visual Improvements**: Better Leaves and Fancy Crops make the world prettier. Resource packs for container GUIs, enchanted books, and icons are pre-enabled. Complementary Shaders (both Reimagined and Unbound) are included and ready to use.

**Multiplayer Features**: Simple Voice Chat is built-in for server play (requires [server-side setup](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)).
